mentions.name: Trebella
mentions.description: Trebella is a tool that helps classical music students structure their practice sessions more effectively. Built in collaboration with actual music teachers, it is used for roughly 90% of the builder's own flute practice and is currently onboarding its first arm's-length users in a closed beta.
mentions.problem: A decade ago the builder tried an interactive music game approach, but found it wasn't actually helpful for intermediate and advanced students, who need more effective structure for their practice sessions.
mentions.audience: Classical music students, especially intermediate and advanced students, with a closed beta for the first independent users.
